{{nihongo|'''Ikeda Shrine'''|池田神社 (静岡市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Suruga Province]].

'''Ikeda Shrine''' (いけだじんじゃ) is a Shinto shrine located in {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}, {{ill|Shizuoka (city)|an|Shizuoka|ar|شيزوكا (مدينة)|arz|شيزوكا (مدينه)|ast|Shizuoka|az|Şizuoka|azb|شیزوئوکا|ban|Shizuoka, Shizuoka|be|Сідзуока (горад)|bg|Шидзуока (град)|br|Shizuoka|ca|Shizuoka|ce|Сидзуока (гӀала)|ceb|Shizuoka-shi (distrito)|cs|Šizuoka|da|Shizuoka|de|Shizuoka|eo|Ŝizuoko|es|Shizuoka|et|Shizuoka|eu|Shizuoka|fa|شیزوئوکا|fi|Shizuoka|fj|Shizuoka|fr|Shizuoka|ga|Shizuoka|gl|Shizuoka|he|שיזואוקה|hi|शिज़ूओका|hu|Sizuoka (település)|hy|Սիձուոկա|id|Shizuoka|is|Shizuoka|it|Shizuoka|ja|静岡市|ka|სიძუოკა|ki|Shizuoka|ko|시즈오카시|lt|Šidzuoka (miestas)|lv|Šidzuoka|mdf|Сидзуока (ошсь)|mg|Shizuoka|mn|Шизүока|mr|शिझुओका|ms|Shizuoka|mzn|شیزوئوکا (شهر)|nl|Shizuoka (stad)|no|Shizuoka|os|Сидзуокæ (сахар)|pl|Shizuoka|pms|Shizuoka|pt|Shizuoka (cidade)|ro|Shizuoka|ru|Сидзуока (город)|sah|Сидзуока|sc|Shizuoka|sco|Shizuoka, Shizuoka|sh|Shizuoka|simple|Shizuoka (city)|sk|Šizuoka|sr|Шизуока|su|Shizuoka, Shizuoka|sv|Shizuoka|sw|Shizuoka, Shizuoka|tg|Шизуока|th|ชิซูโอกะ (นคร)|tl|Shizuoka|tok|ma tomo Sisujoka|tr|Şizuoka|tt|Сидзуока (шәһәр)|tum|Shizuoka|uk|Сідзуока|ur|شیزوکا|uz|Shizuoka|vep|Sidzuok (lidn)|vi|Shizuoka (thành phố)|war|Shizuoka (syudad)|wuu|静冈市|zh|靜岡市|zh_classical|靜岡市|zh_min_nan|Sizuoka-chhī|zh_yue|靜岡市|qid=Q174691}}, {{ill|Suruga-ku, Shizuoka|ar|سوروغا-كو|ceb|Suruga Ku|fa|سوروگا-کو، نیگاتا|fr|Suruga-ku|id|Suruga-ku, Shizuoka|it|Suruga-ku|ja|駿河区|ko|스루가구|tr|Suruga (semt)|uk|Район Суруґа|ur|سوروگا وارڈ، شیزوکا|zh|駿河區|qid=Q1042630}}.<ref>[http://www.shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4406075 Ikeda Shrine] - Shizuoka Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines</ref>

=== Overview ===
It is situated on the northwestern foothills of {{ill|Nihondaira|fr|Nihondaira|ja|日本平|ko|니혼다이라|zh|日本平|qid=Q4026928}}, on the south side of the {{ill|Daijihīn River|ja|大慈悲院川|qid=Q111830290}}.

Although the date of foundation is unknown, it is an ancient shrine identified with a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} of the same name.<ref name="oz">[https://humizuki.com/omaturi_zanmai/sight/jinja/sizuoka/ikeda.htm Ikeda Shrine] - Omatsuri Zanmai</ref><ref name="genbu">[https://genbu.net/data/suruga/ikeda_title.htm Ikeda Shrine] - Genbushi</ref>
